official_method.name: AIGI-Det-Calib
official_method.license: No license file found at the fixed commit; no upstream code is vendored here.

released_code_findings.n_shots_bug: run_n_experiment accepts n_shot but calls balanced_sample(label.numpy()) without forwarding it; actual released sample count is always balanced_sample's default 20.
released_code_findings.label_use_in_unsupervised_path: The unsupervised core ignores label values, but run.py selects its calibration subset with balanced_sample(label), exactly 10 real and 10 fake in the released path.
released_code_findings.paper_release_mismatch: Paper: 100 images and 10 runs. README text: 50 shots and 20 runs. CLI defaults: 100 shots and 20 runs. Released execution: 20 shots and 20 runs.
released_code_findings.benchmark_std_axis: run.py averages the experiment axis before taking std across datasets; it does not compute the stated benchmark-level variation across experiments.
released_code_findings.unsupervised_solution: For real_ratio=0.5, the released moment objective estimates the target logit mean; an additive offset changes Accuracy but preserves ranking and AUC.

audit_adapter.location_policy: One-off adapter executed from /tmp and not added to the project repository.
audit_adapter.score_conversion: Saved float32 sigmoid probabilities were inverted to logits; exact zero was clipped to float32 tiny.

base_result.validation: All 468 target-level base AUC/Accuracy checks (3 methods x 2 seeds x 39 targets x 2 metrics) matched exactly; maximum absolute difference 0.

protocols.primary: Strict label-free random 100-shot subset selection, 10 deterministic repetitions, official unsupervised core, evaluation on the 100-shot-excluded holdout.
protocols.released_exact: 20 label-balanced shots due to release bug, 20 repetitions, average offset evaluated on the complete target.
protocols.paper_intended: 100 label-balanced shots, 10 repetitions, complete-target evaluation; includes target-label-dependent selection.
protocols.oracle: Best additive offset using every target label; diagnostic ceiling only.
